433-eros.x: Near-Earth asteroid station infected with the Phoebe Protomolecule during the Eros Incident in Leviathan Wakes.
433-eros.a: James S. A. Corey (Daniel Abraham & Ty Franck)

433-eros.x: Asteroid 433 Eros converted into the subterranean International Fleet Command School where Ender conducts the decisive simulation campaigns.
First asteroid orbited and landed upon by a spacecraft (NEAR Shoemaker in February 2001).
